name: test-flake-and-hang-stabilization
title: Stabilize the flaky allocation gate and the hanging test run
description: The release test suite is not deterministically green on this tree: HotPathAllocationGateTests.ReverseRewriteAndInjectAllocatesNoManagedBytes fails roughly 1 run in 6 with Expected 0 / Actual 7520 (in isolation as well as under the full suite), and one full-suite run hung for 41 minutes at ~0% CPU with 83 threads parked on futex and 60+ wf-setup-* threads waiting. Both were observed while building the benchmark-coverage task and are pre-existing, not caused by it. This task reproduces both, finds the root cause, fixes it, and leaves evidence that the suite is stable across repeated runs.
creator: qmazon
